# Karmatix Learning Catalog

> Engineering education the clear way.

Karmatix Learning is an open engineering catalog publishing practical, rigorous technical courses built on real tested code. All courses are completely free with no account required.

## Live Courses

- Karmatix .NET Academy: Comprehensive .NET 10 LTS and C# 14 engineering course covering clean architecture, ASP.NET Core APIs, Entity Framework Core, Docker containers, automated testing, and interview preparation with 16 tested projects. URL: https://karma-tic.github.io/dotnet-academy/
- Karmatix Flutter Course: Self-paced cross-platform mobile development with Dart 3 and Flutter 3, featuring Android native Kotlin comparisons, timed mock exams, and practical calculation labs. URL: https://karma-tic.github.io/flutter-course/

## Upcoming Courses

- Cloud and DevOps Architecture: Production container orchestration, Terraform infrastructure as code, and CI/CD pipelines.
- AI and Python for Production: Asynchronous Python, LLM orchestration, evaluation pipelines, and vector databases.
- Distributed Systems and Microservices: Resilient distributed architectures, event-driven messaging, and observability.
